prompt: Vertical 9:16 illustration. Create a dense retro-futuristic megacity poster in clean comic style. Precise black ink outlines, flat saturated colors, crisp vector-like linework, subtle hand-drawn irregularity, minimal soft shading, no photorealism. Pastel-neon palette: lavender sky, mint, turquoise, coral, peach, yellow, cyan, teal, pale blue, soft pink. Composition: very tall frame. Top skyline under lavender sky. Left side features colorful Moscow-inspired landmarks: red clock tower with green roof and star, onion domes, pale blue gothic skyscrapers, mint clock-tower high-rise. Center top dominated by a huge teal cylindrical glass skyscraper with stacked rounded sections, vertical window stripes, dark bands. Right side packed with sharp pastel skyscrapers in blue, pink, yellow, turquoise. Middle zone: dense city blocks with many windows, bridges, elevated roads, skybridges, billboards, screens with stylized human faces, flower icons, black sign panels. Include fictional text signs: "Sintez Tokio", "Nieuw Moskou", "MegaCity Anonymous". Buildings tightly packed, geometric, varied heights. Lower middle: Amsterdam-inspired canal district with red brick houses, pitched roofs, arched bridges, bright cyan water, tiny boat, narrow streets, railings. Bottom foreground: large pale mint architectural facade with a centered archway. Inside sits a tiny bald bearded man with round glasses on a simple chair, holding a book or tablet. He is small compared to the city, contemplative and isolated. Interior walls pale yellow and mint with clean shadows. Mood: bright, strange, melancholic, humorous, utopian-dystopian. Keep strong vertical scale hierarchy and dense layered city depth. --ar 9:16 --profile 9pe64mi --niji 7
